    """Overlay the nonzero cells above and below the solid divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h - 1)

    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("panels must have equal height")

             for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
